title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
abstract: arXiv:2609.37670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics

translated_title: MeanFlowAdvantage：面向少步平均速度生成器的稳定奖励微调
translated_abstract: MeanFlow 通过预测区间平均速度实现高效的少步生成，但这种表示方式与奖励微调之间存在失配：现有的基于优势函数的目标通常定义在瞬时速度或等价的 x0 空间预测上，而推理阶段直接使用的是学习到的平均速度映射。我们提出 MeanFlowAdvantage，一种面向平均速度生成器的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标。其关键构造是使用一个共享的、梯度分离的 MeanFlow 导数校正，在预测空间中表达奖励目标，同时将 rollout（展开采样）与参考正则化转化为对推理时部署的平均速度网络的精确惩罚项。由此得到的公式保留了 MeanFlow 原生的少步采样器，并提供了一种将奖励改进直接迁移到已部署流映射的机制。在 SD3.5-Medium 上，MeanFlowAdvantage 在全部八项报告指标上均取得提升。
tldr: 提出 MeanFlowAdvantage——一种带符号优势加权最小二乘目标，通过共享的 MeanFlow 导数校正解决平均速度生成器与优势奖励微调之间的失配问题，在保留原生少步采样的同时将奖励改进直接迁移到部署的流映射，并在 SD3.5-Medium 全部八项指标上取得提升。
en_tdlr: MeanFlowAdvantage introduces a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective with a shared detached MeanFlow derivative correction, resolving the mismatch between reward fine-tuning and average-velocity generators while preserving the native few-step sampler and directly transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map, improving all eight metrics on SD3.5-Medium.
